facts.text: Under the TWU Pledge, incoming Tennessee freshmen who qualify for the HOPE Scholarship and have a family adjusted gross income of $50,000 or less attend tuition-free.

sources.title: TWUPledge | Tennessee Wesleyan University
sources.quote: The TWU Pledge is a last-dollar tuition scholarship that will allow HOPE Scholarship eligible new freshman students with a family adjusted gross income of $50,000 or less to attend Tennessee Wesleyan University tuition-free!
